IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PROD alert: runtime OOMs detected on prod-gpu-pool-3 (multiple hosts). Paging on-call. Incident ID: INC-2026-042. See /incidents/INC-2026-042
Jamie: I'm on it, paging page on-call. Seeing a spike in 5xx for /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings.
Priya: I can take first pass, on-call. Which customers are impacted? any big ones?
Jamie: Top affected route: embeddings.batch with 95th latency spike, error rate ~18% over last 6m. Customer A reported degraded search results. Cust B saw increased timeout errors.
Marcus: grabbing logs from the time window 2026-03-17T13:07:00Z - 2026-03-17T13:18:00Z. Uploading tail to s3: s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-2026-042/prod-gpu-pool-3-tail.txt
Sasha: quick telemetry: GPU mem usage shows sustained >96% on host gpu-3a for ~4m, then multiple page faults. KV cache size jumped ~2.4x compared to baseline.
Jamie: hypothesis: KV cache fragmentation + sudden larger batches caused allocations to spike -> runtime OOM and paging. Recent rollout 2026-03-17T12:55 included model variant v2 that increased default max_batch_size to 8.
Priya: can we confirm batch size distribution? Marcus, can you pull the distribution from metrics? prometheus query? maybe `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le))`
Marcus: pasted 95p batch size from metrics: `p50=2, p90=6, p95=8` post-rollout. Pre-rollout p95 was 4.
Sasha: also seeing increased KV cache misses and cold starts -> more KV allocations per request, combined with big batches -> KV cache growth.
Jamie: share logs snippet of OOM backtrace:
```
[2026-03-17T13:09:12Z] runtime: Alloc failed: requested 52428800 bytes, available 0
[2026-03-17T13:09:12Z] gpu0: mem_total=40GB mem_used=39.2GB kv_cache=6.1GB slabs=2.3GB
[2026-03-17T13:09:12Z] paging: pagewalks=2048 spikes=3
```
Priya: immediate mitigation options: 1) revert rollout (painful), 2) temporarily reduce max_batch_size for embeddings route to 4, 3) lower KV cache retention threshold (eviction) to free slabs sooner. Prefer #2+3 as quick fix.
Jamie: agree. I'm going to push a runtime config update to reduce batch_size and set kv_eviction_threshold=0.6. Will run canary on 10% traffic.
Marcus: command to patch route config (prod):
```
curl -XPOST https://api.redwood.internal/configs/route/update \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","max_batch_size":4}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
Sasha: rolling that now to 10% canary on pool-3.
[13:14:02] Sasha: canary applied to 10% traffic.
Jamie: monitoring metrics... 2m after canary: errors down from 18% -> 6% on canary hosts, GPU mem usage dropped ~8%.
Priya: great. Start widening to 50% and set kv_eviction: `kv.set_config(pool="prod-gpu-pool-3", eviction_threshold=0.6)`
Marcus: eviction change applied. Telemetry: slab freed ~800MB across hosts in 1m.
Jamie: widening to 100% now.
[13:22:40] IncidentBot: AUTO: routing adjusted to fallback variant for overloaded hosts. Note: customers on older pinned variants unaffected.
Priya: after widening, global 5xx fell to baseline (~0.8%). Latency p95 improved from 1.2s -> 750ms for embeddings.
Sasha: capturing timeline for RCA: events list
- 12:55 deploy of model v2 with default max_batch_size=8
- 13:07 first OOMs observed on prod-gpu-pool-3
- 13:09 paging escalated, logs show mem pressure and pagewalks
- 13:14 canary batch_size->4 applied (10%)
- 13:16 kv_eviction_threshold lowered to 0.6
- 13:22 widened to 100%, errors remediated
Marcus: saving telemetry graphs and logs to s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-2026-042/analysis/
Jamie: next steps for RCA: collect heap snapshots from affected hosts, run KV cache fragmentation analysis, correlate batch size distribution with KV allocation spikes. Also review rollout gating to prevent large p95 batch increases.
Priya: taking on the RCA owner role. I'll coordinate with runtime/serving to get core dumps and memory traces. Assigning follow-ups: @Marcus get full allocation traces, @Sasha run kvdefrag simulation locally, @Jamie doc customer impacts and comms.
Jamie: handing off live ops to Priya for the night. Summary in one line: mitigated via batch-size rollback + kv_eviction tuning, customers restored. :thumbsup:
Priya: thanks Jamie. I'll keep the channel updated with RCA progress and post a brief for CS for impacted customers.
Marcus: uploading debug bundle now, ETA ~12m.
Priya: noted. If anyone sees regressions after widen, ping me immediately. Closing live mitigation phase, moving to RCA phase. :white_check_mark:
